versionImpact.rationale: Buildchain v2.10 patch release accepts strict publish-gate channel-lineage PRs and supports web-surface managed-network health verification without requiring public runner access.

surfaceImpacts.rationale: Accepts same-line publish-gate/alpha and publish-gate/release source-lock PR lineage during promote-buildchain-ref governance checks.

Allows web-surface deploy channels to declare directory_index_rewrite = external so Buildchain does not replace an existing viewer-request prefix router while health checks still validate root and nested surface URLs.

Channels declared access_control = managed-network now skip public HTTP fetches from GitHub-hosted runners, verify live applies with S3 head-object checks for manifests and smoke target objects, fall back to deployment evidence for dry-run/plan-only checks, and allow explicit private-network runner HTTP smoke checks.

summary: Buildchain v2.10 patch release for publish-gate lineage, web-surface routing, and managed-network health verification.
